prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production decorative background strip for the bottom of lizz.dev, landscape approximately 3:1.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE: the approved "Forest edge" website concept. Extract its scenery, not its UI.
Primary request: create ONLY the low-poly forest edge illustration from the bottom of that concept as an isolated reusable background asset. No website, typography, logo, icons or text anywhere.
Scene: a quiet miniature isometric low-poly pine forest on subtle angular slate terrain. Dark desaturated teal-green tiered pine trees, charcoal trunks, a few small matte angular rocks. Match the reference's restrained palette and tree shapes. The whole scene should be low contrast when placed on solid #172128.
Composition: very wide shallow strip. Taller pine clusters hugging the lower left and right edges, a few small scattered trees near the lower corners and bottom center. The center is a wide empty clearing. The very top half is completely transparent negative space. Trees and ground occupy the bottom half, with the outermost tallest pines rising into the lower two thirds at the far corners. Ground facets fade softly to transparency along their upper boundary; no hard horizontal or rectangular edge. Bottom of the ground continues beyond the bottom image edge. Keep details crisp and simple, not noisy.
Lighting: soft dim ambient light, understated highlights on a few triangular tree faces, no bright rim light.
Color palette: slate #172128, nearby blue-charcoal terrain, very muted evergreen #203d38 and #29483e.
Output: real transparent background, no colored rectangular backdrop, no checkerboard painted into the illustration.
Avoid: UI or screenshots, any letters or numbers, buildings, people, extra objects, photorealism, glowing lights, bright greens, dramatic fog, excessive detail, gradients as scene decoration.
